    21	/-- Coordinates with the same label form a block. No restriction on block sizes
    22	or positivity of the ambient dimension is imposed. -/
    23	def IsBlockSplitting {n m : ℕ} (block : Fin n → Fin m)
    24	    (A D N : RealMatrix n) : Prop :=
    25	  A = D + N ∧
    26	  (∀ i j, block i ≠ block j → D i j = 0) ∧
    27	  (∀ i j, block i = block j → N i j = 0)

    29	/-- The diagonal blocks of the original input matrix. -/
    30	def diagonalBlocks {n m : ℕ} (block : Fin n → Fin m)
    31	    (A : RealMatrix n) : RealMatrix n :=
    32	  fun i j => if block i = block j then A i j else 0

    34	/-- The off-diagonal blocks of the original input matrix. -/
    35	def offDiagonalBlocks {n m : ℕ} (block : Fin n → Fin m)
    36	    (A : RealMatrix n) : RealMatrix n :=
    37	  A - diagonalBlocks block A

    39	/-- The exact residual at an arbitrary current approximation. -/
    40	def residual {n : ℕ} (A : RealMatrix n) (b u : Vector n) : Vector n :=
    41	  b - A.mulVec u

    43	/-- The correction obtained by solving with the diagonal-block matrix.
    44	Nonsingularity is an explicit assumption of the theorem below. -/
    45	def correction {n : ℕ} (A D : RealMatrix n) (b u : Vector n) : Vector n :=
    46	  D⁻¹.mulVec (residual A b u)

    48	/-- The update-form Jacobi map. -/
    49	def update {n : ℕ} (A D : RealMatrix n) (b u : Vector n) : Vector n :=

    53	def iterate {n : ℕ} (A D : RealMatrix n) (b x₀ : Vector n) : ℕ → Vector n
    54	  | 0 => x₀
    55	  | k + 1 => update A D b (iterate A D b x₀ k)

   244	/-- Full update-form block-Jacobi theorem in exact real arithmetic.
   245	
   246	The only hypotheses are the block splitting, nonsingularity of D, and Ax=b.

   254	    {n m : ℕ} (block : Fin n → Fin m)
   255	    (A D N : RealMatrix n) (b x : Vector n)
   256	    (hblocks : IsBlockSplitting block A D N)

   260	    -- The block model is exactly the diagonal/off-diagonal decomposition of A.
   261	    (D = diagonalBlocks block A ∧ N = offDiagonalBlocks block A) ∧
   262	    -- The constructed iteration solves the correction system and performs the update.

   264	      iterate A D b x₀ 0 = x₀ ∧
   265	      ∀ k : ℕ,
   266	        D.mulVec (correctionSequence A D b x₀ (k + 1)) =
   267	          b - A.mulVec (iterate A D b x₀ k) ∧
   268	        iterate A D b x₀ (k + 1) =
   269	          iterate A D b x₀ k + correctionSequence A D b x₀ (k + 1)) ∧
   270	    -- Thus the result also applies to every exact sequence specified in the source.
   271	    (∀ (x₀ : Vector n) (X C : ℕ → Vector n),
   272	      X 0 = x₀ →
   273	      (∀ k, D.mulVec (C (k + 1)) = b - A.mulVec (X k)) →
   274	      (∀ k, X (k + 1) = X k + C (k + 1)) →
   275	      (∀ k, X k = iterate A D b x₀ k) ∧
   276	      (∀ k, C (k + 1) = correctionSequence A D b x₀ (k + 1))) ∧
   277	    -- Error recursion and its two distinct quantitative bounds.
   278	    (∀ (x₀ : Vector n) (k : ℕ),
   279	      error A D b x₀ x (k + 1) = P.mulVec (error A D b x₀ x k) ∧
   280	      error A D b x₀ x k = (P ^ k).mulVec (error A D b x₀ x 0) ∧
   281	      vectorAbs (error A D b x₀ x k) ≤
   282	        (matrixAbs P ^ k).mulVec (vectorAbs (error A D b x₀ x 0)) ∧
   283	      ‖error A D b x₀ x k‖ ≤
   284	        matrixInfNorm P ^ k * ‖error A D b x₀ x 0‖) ∧
   285	    -- The sign does not affect the usual complex spectral radius.
   286	    rho P = rho (D⁻¹ * N) ∧
   287	    (ConvergesForEveryInitialGuess A D b x ↔ rho P < 1) ∧
   288	    -- Lipschitz estimate for the update map, with the stated contraction factor.
   289	    (∀ u v : Vector n,
   290	      ‖update A D b u - update A D b v‖ ≤ matrixInfNorm P * ‖u - v‖) ∧
   291	    (matrixInfNorm P < 1 →
   292	      ConvergesForEveryInitialGuess A D b x ∧
   293	      ∃ q : NNReal, (q : ℝ) = matrixInfNorm P ∧ q < 1 ∧
